component.name: CWS Universal Base
component.summary: Kingdom Technology dashboard and CPI-SI tooling

description.p: CWS Universal Base is the native desktop application for CreativeWorkzStudio's Kingdom Technology stack. It provides real-time dashboards for CPI-SI state monitoring, SDK hook inspection, and system observability.
Built on a ViewModel architecture with GTK4, designed to grow into MillenniumOS — a full desktop environment founded on biblical principles.

ul.li: Dashboard module with real-time CPI-SI state monitoring
SDK Inspector module for hook I/O visualization
